policy: Readiness derives from native lifecycle journals, full JSONL requests/responses, and ordered archived native traces. A driver's pass flag is never evidence.
required_evidence: successful lifecycle for all 12 actions including real pose/segment evidence
bounded pending commands and unique command execution
fault refusals and cancellation before startup
single body owner including soft action, dialog and native takeover
wall watchdog native fallback at a safe boundary in realtime
lockstep provider loss classified as infrastructure failure
strict archived native-off parity for seeds 17, 29 and 43
CPU headless resource descriptors and unchanged production service states
limitations: No neural model or training is part of this stage.
Fixture mutations establish test states; all action execution, animation, collision and damage use the native engine.
Continue is a continuation of an existing segment and does not claim a new animation start.
Wall watchdog timing is measured independently from simulation time.
